extracted.intended_audience: designers, marketers, presenters, and learners interested in infographics and data visualization
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and training-oriented standards for creating infographics and data visualizations tailored to marketing, reports, presentations, posters, and resumes, with emphasis on storytelling and effective PowerPoint charts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create compelling, medium-appropriate infographics
rubrics_metrics.description: Infographics should be compelling and designed for the target medium (online marketing, business reports, posters, presentations, or infographic resumes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Cool Infographics book 'prepares you to create compelling infographics for online marketing, business reports, posters, presentations, and even design your own infographic resume.' Tailor visualizations to the use-case and audience (external marketing vs internal reports vs printed posters).

rubrics_metrics.name: Customize charts to communicate your insights and key message
rubrics_metrics.description: Charts must be customized so they effectively communicate the creator's own insights and the key message to the intended audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As stated on the page: 'Most PowerPoint charts suck! You need to customize your charts to effectively communicate your own insights and key message to your audience in a unique, memorable way.' Emphasize clarity, message-first design, and memorability over default/chart-bank visuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use storytelling in data visualization
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ storytelling techniques when presenting data to make visualizations more persuasive and easier to understand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The author teaches a 'Data Visualization and Storytelling Certificate' course, indicating an evaluative emphasis on combining data visualization with narrative structure. The course format (12-week, hybrid, cohort) is designed to help learners create story-driven visualizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply core data visualization design best practices (including for PowerPoint)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow established data visualization design best practices (the page references 'five data visualization design best practices') particularly when creating charts in PowerPoint.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Skillshare class 'will focus applying five data visualization design best practices to charts created in Microsoft PowerPoint.' While the five practices are not enumerated on this page, the guidance recommends explicit best-practice application rather than default chart usage.
